_help: Site-wide settings. Edit, then run: python3 build.py && python3 build.py --check. See README.md.
name: Makers Inspire
_logo_help: Logo files (MI monogram from brand/mi-monogram-source.png, drawn by tools/make_brand.py). logo = black horizontal lockup for light areas (header, shown 28-34px tall). logo_stacked = black stacked lockup, MI over MAKERS INSPIRE as on the booth banner (footer, home-page sign). logo_dark = white horizontal lockup for dark areas (none on the site yet). null logo = text wordmark. Favicons, app icons and images/og-logo.png are made by the same tool.
_checkout_help: Checkout uses Stripe Payment Links: paste each piece's link (https://buy.stripe.com/...) into its stripe_link in pieces.json. Pieces without a link show an 'Ask about this piece' button that opens the contact form.
_form_help: Formspree POST endpoints, one per form (contact = /contact/, commission = /commissions/). Each form sends _subject and the _gotcha honeypot; site.js submits with fetch and goes to /thanks/ (without JS the form posts normally and Formspree shows its own thank-you page). Remove a key (or set it to null) and that form falls back to opening the visitor's email app with a prefilled message to contact_email.
_contact_help: Confirmed address (provided by Noah). Used only by the forms' mailto fallback. show_contact_email: false keeps it off every page (no plain address in the page source); true shows it on the Contact page and under the forms.
